sources.entry: better-ccflare by tombii - A well-maintained and feature-enhanced fork of the glorious ccflare usage dashboard by @snipeship. better-ccflare builds on that foundation with performance enhancements, extended provider support, bug fixes, Docker deployment, and more.

summary.one_liner: better-ccflare is a fork of the ccflare usage dashboard that runs as a Claude API proxy, load-balancing requests across multiple accounts and providers while tracking usage, latency, and costs.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a Claude API proxy that distributes requests across multiple accounts to avoid rate-limit errors, with automatic fallback to preferred accounts when their limits reset. It supports many provider types, including Claude OAuth, Claude API console, Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock, OpenRouter, Codex (OpenAI OAuth), xAI/Grok, and generic Anthropic-compatible and OpenAI-compatible endpoints. It monitors OAuth token health with automatic refresh and logs every request, response, and error trace. It records latency, token usage, and costs, and includes a real-time dashboard and request logs. It also translates POST /v1/responses and /v1/responses/compact requests into Anthropic /v1/messages calls. An opt-in Codex continuation mode (CCFLARE_CODEX_MESSAGES_CONTINUATION) reuses server-side response IDs for Claude Messages clients, and is off by default. Optional API key authentication is also listed.
use_cases: load balance Claude API requests across multiple accounts
avoid rate limit errors on Claude accounts
track API token usage and costs per request
proxy OpenAI-compatible providers behind Claude API format
monitor OAuth token health for Claude accounts
debug request and response traffic to LLM APIs
how_to_run: npm install (or bun install) with Node.js >= 18 or Bun >= 1.2.8
Or download a pre-compiled binary for Linux, macOS, or Windows
Docker deployment (mentioned in the awesome-list description; not detailed in the README)
notable: Multi-account load balancing with automatic fallback to preferred accounts
Responses API compatibility layer translating to Anthropic /v1/messages
Opt-in Codex continuation for Claude Messages clients with per-account, per-model state isolation
Pre-compiled binaries for Linux, macOS, and Windows with no runtime needed
Real-time dashboard with request logs and analytics
caveats: ARM32 devices (Raspberry Pi Zero, Pi 1, Pi 2, 32-bit OS) are not supported
Windows is supported only as a pre-compiled binary, not via npm
Codex continuation depends on endpoint retention of response IDs and needs endpoint-specific validation
keywords: see what my claude calls cost
